description: Optimizes Cyprus LTD company-director remuneration for monetary inputs up to €1,000,000, with a fixed solver evaluation budget. Use for a Cyprus LTD director remuneration comparison. Monetary inputs may not exceed €1,000,000; larger values are rejected before solving. Require company profit/revenue, deductible expenses, tax year and domicile status; reuse supplied data and request missing essentials. The default €2,000 corporate administration cost is a disclosed modelling assumption.

annualCorporateAdminCost.description: Annual corporate admin, audit and compliance costs in EUR (Cyprus Companies Law Cap. 113). Defaults to 2000; maximum €1,000,000.

corporateGrossProfit.description: Annual company turnover/revenue in EUR, before operating expenses. Maximum supported value: €1,000,000.

directorSalaryAllocation.description: Optional fixed director salary in EUR (maximum €1,000,000); omit to run the bounded solver for the optimal split.

isNonDomiciled.description: Non-dom status; exempts dividends from SDC.

operatingExpenses.description: Annual deductible operating expenses in EUR (maximum €1,000,000).

name: optimize_company_director_remuneration
